item.title: Ask for a Name on the Poster
item.prompt_text: Your group made a poster. Your name is not on it. You are Lina Park. Ask the group to add your name under the picture, next to Mia's name. The poster is going on the wall tomorrow.
item.audience: people making a school poster with you
item.target_grammar: My name is and next to. Use can you for a request.
item.target_structure: Explain what is missing, spell out your full name, and tell the team where to put it.

checklist.point: Say that your name is missing.
